# 4 Ezra Chapter 12 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin Vulgate (Codex Sangermanensis) | **Section:** Core apocalypse — Eagle vision interpreted

---

**1** While the lion was still speaking to the eagle, I watched —

**2** and the remaining head disappeared. The two wings that had joined it rose up and set themselves up to reign. Their reign was short and chaotic.

**3** Then they too disappeared. The entire body of the eagle burst into flame, and the earth was seized with sheer terror.

**4** Then I woke from the deep trance that had held me, filled with overwhelming fear, and said to myself:

**5** Look what you have brought on yourself by searching out the ways of the Most High!

**6** My mind is still exhausted and my spirit completely depleted. I have no strength left at all because of the sheer terror of last night.

**7** Now I must beg the Most High to sustain me to the end.

**8** I said: O LORD my God — if I have found favor in your sight, if I am more righteous before you than many others, if my prayer has truly come before your face —

**9** give me strength, and reveal to your servant the interpretation of this terrifying vision. Bring my soul the comfort it needs.

**10** You have seen fit to show me the end of the times and the final events of the ages.

**11** He said to me: Here is the interpretation of the vision you saw:

**12** The eagle you saw coming up from the sea is the fourth kingdom that appeared in a vision to your brother Daniel.

**13** But it was not explained to him the way I am explaining it to you now.

**14** The days are coming when a kingdom will arise on earth, and it will be more terrible than any kingdom before it.

**15** Twelve kings will reign in it, one after another.

**16** But the second to reign will hold power longer than any of the twelve.

**17** That is the meaning of the twelve wings you saw.

**18** And the voice you heard — the one that spoke not from the heads but from the middle of the body — this is the meaning:

**19** There will be massive internal conflict in this kingdom, and it will come close to collapse; but it will not fall at that point — it will recover and restore its original power.

**20** And the eight small wings clinging to the large wings — this is the meaning:

**21** Eight kings will arise within this kingdom, with short reigns and brief years.

**22** Two of them will perish when the midpoint of the kingdom comes; four will survive until the end begins to approach; and two will last until the very end.

**23** And the three resting heads — this is the meaning:

**24** In the kingdom's last days the Most High will raise up three kings, and they will revive many things within it, and rule over the earth

**25** and its inhabitants with greater oppression than any before them. This is why they are called the heads of the eagle.

**26** For it is they who will bring its wickedness to its peak and complete its final acts.

**27** The great middle head disappearing means: one of these kings will die in his bed, though in agony.

**28** The other two will be cut down by the sword.

**29** The sword of one will consume the other; but in the end that one too will fall by the sword.

**30** And the two small wings that transferred to the right-side head —

**31** this is the meaning: these are those kept by the Most High for the end. This is the small, troubled kingdom you saw.

**32** And the lion you saw emerging from the forest, roaring and speaking to the eagle, condemning it for its injustice, with all the words you heard —

**33** he is the Messiah whom the Most High has been preserving until the end of days. He will descend from the line of David. He will come and confront them, laying out their wickedness and their evil deeds before them.

**34** First he will bring them before his judgment seat while they are still alive, and after condemning them he will destroy them.

**35** But the rest of my people — those preserved throughout my territory — he will rescue with mercy and make them rejoice until the end comes, the day of judgment I described to you at the beginning.

**36** That is the dream you saw. That is its meaning.

**37** You alone were found worthy to receive this secret of the Most High.

**38** Write everything you have seen in a book and hide it away.

**39** Teach it to those among your people who are wise — those whose hearts you know can receive and guard these secrets.

**40** But don't stay here yourself. Go somewhere no human being has ever lived.

**41** For you will be taken away from among humanity, and from this point you will live with my son and with those who resemble you, until the times come to their end.

**42** For the world has passed its youth, and the times are growing old.

**43** The world has been divided into ten parts; nine of those parts have already come and gone, and now half the tenth part is slipping away.

**44** So put your affairs in order. Rebuke your people. Comfort those among them who are broken. Educate those who are wise.

**45** Let go of this corruptible life. Release the thought of mortal existence. Set down the weight of being human. Shed the weakness of the body.

**46** Put aside all your most agonizing thoughts, and hurry to leave these times behind.

**47** For worse evils than anything you have seen are still to come; the kings of the nations are growing stronger,

**48** and as their wickedness intensifies, I and those like me will be in anguish.

**49** Three days later I was sitting under an oak tree, alone.

**50** All the people had assembled to grieve because I had been gone so long. I opened my mouth and began speaking to them.

**51** I said: Listen to me, Israel! Pay attention to my words, you descendants of Jacob!
